# verifiedNepal

> Independent, volunteer-run service keeping a checked record of disaster and relief information for Nepal. People can ask for help, find needs they can respond to, and read information from official sources. Not a government website; it makes already-public disaster information easier to read. Bilingual (English / नेपाली), mobile-first.

The site attempts to refresh NDRRMA figures every 5 minutes while open. Bundled figures are shown when a complete refresh is unavailable; each situation block identifies its source and time. Person records appear only after a name search. Always verify individual records and follow emergency guidance on the official government sources linked below, not this site.

## Pages

- [Home](https://verifiednepal.com/): ask for help or give help, rescue figures with source and time, relief map, official updates.
- [Find a person](https://verifiednepal.com/search): search NDRRMA’s rescued and missing-person lists by name, in Nepali or English. The page separately links to public lost-and-found reports on the official OPMCM portal. Not indexed (results are per-query, not a browsable listing).
- [Someone is missing](https://verifiednepal.com/missing): step-by-step guide for families — search the lists, register on the OPMCM portal, police/DAO report, hospitals, the Rasuwagadhi border channel, scam warning, official hotlines.
- [Get help](https://verifiednepal.com/get-help): request goods, shelter, transport or medical support; requests are checked before they are listed.
- [Give help](https://verifiednepal.com/give-help): respond to checked needs or register an offer.
- [Drop centres](https://verifiednepal.com/drop-centers): registered collection points for relief goods and their current status.
- [Projects](https://verifiednepal.com/projects): checked infrastructure needs (tuin, bridges, trails, water, schools); committees receive payments directly.
- [Ledger](https://verifiednepal.com/ledger): public record of fulfilled aid, who received what, where and when. Nothing private is shown.
- [Audit log](https://verifiednepal.com/audit): every moderator action, newest first, with names and targets masked.
- [Articles](https://verifiednepal.com/articles): moderated community writing on mountains and climate; each article lives at /articles/{id}.
- [Info & Help](https://verifiednepal.com/info): official emergency hotlines, data sources, how to report a missing person or ask for help.
- [Privacy & Terms](https://verifiednepal.com/privacy): data handling, liability, and source-attribution policy.

## Official sources mirrored here

- [NDRRMA rescues API](https://ndrrma.gov.np/api/v1/rescues/) — rescued/missing counts, person records, locations, official messages.
- [OPMCM rescue portal](https://rescue.opmcm.gov.np/) — help-request coordination stats and government effort updates.

## Notes

- This site sets no cookies and runs no analytics.
- Source: [github.com/onlyutils/verified-nepal](https://github.com/onlyutils/verified-nepal).
